body:
Adds `research/rank-elicitation`: paying verifiers for the ranking of K classes with a linear rank-weight score.

- Strictly proper; adjacent-swap regret exactly `(p_i−p_j)(w_r−w_{r+1})`
- Beats Brier-derived rankings per unit payment range for gaps below `1/(K−1)`
- Equal spacing is optimal, top-k set costs the same as the mode, worst report is the reversed ranking
- Detection sample size for a swap is identical to Brier's
- Stdlib-only, 7 tests passing; README and portfolio page updated
